verification_level: FAST plus BATCH; no STOP (no confirmed memory-safety defect left unrepaired, no ABI regression, no hidden obligation and no remaining unsafe-safe-Rust API); two checked-arithmetic/NULL-UB repairs and one secret-residue failure-path improvement
scope: Per-file contract audit of the four PKCS12_key_gen spellings and the PKCS12KDF engine, the PKCS12 MAC presence/read/setup/generate/verify/PBMAC1 units, the PKCS12 password-change workers, both PKCS8_decrypt and both PKCS8_encrypt spellings, the OPENSSL_asc2uni/uni2asc/utf82uni/uni2utf8 conversions plus the four PKCS12 BIO/FILE wrappers, BIO_new_PKCS7, and the PKCS7 SMIMECapabilities/content-type/signing-time/digest attribute helpers. evp/method_store.rs was deferred as the method-store registry boundary; pkcs7/pk7_attr.rs was substituted from position 9 of the queue. PKCS#12 passwords, converted UTF-16 forms, PBKDF2/GOST/HMAC keys and decrypted private-key encodings are SECRET_DATA; salts, iteration counts, algorithm identifiers, MAC values and ciphertext are PUBLIC_DATA. No constant-time claim is made for any file from source inspection.

files_not_run.reason: Method-store registry and OSSL_METHOD_CONSTRUCT_METHOD dispatch boundary (store locking, construct/reserve/unreserve callbacks, method cache). Deferred for a dedicated boundary audit; it remains in REMAINING-AUDIT.txt at the head of the queue.

defects.description: asclen * 2 + 2 (OPENSSL_asc2uni), ulen += 2/4 (OPENSSL_utf82uni) and asclen += j/+1 (OPENSSL_uni2utf8) were unchecked signed additions. Overflow panics in debug and wraps in release, turning the allocation size into a bogus value (the subsequent slice write then panics) instead of returning the ordinary failure answer; the authority has the same signed overflow, and AGENTS.md section 17 forbids reproducing it.
defects.fix: Every sizing step uses checked_mul/checked_add and refuses with the ordinary NULL answer before allocating. No exported signature or release seam changed.
defects.witness: forensics/authorities/src/openssl-3.6.4/crypto/pkcs12/p12_utl.c:17-43,77-148,181-235; the new unit test refuses asclen = INT_MAX/2 + 1 before any read.

defects.class: undefined pointer arithmetic on NULL permitted by the documented contract
defects.description: OPENSSL_uni2asc executed uni.add(1) unconditionally after the empty-length guard, while its # Safety contract permitted (NULL, 0). pointer.add on null is Rust UB even though the authority's uni++ is never dereferenced for an empty input. The contracts of the four conversions also allowed NULL with non-zero lengths.
defects.fix: The leading-byte skip is conditional on unilen != 0, preserving the authority's one-byte empty string for (NULL, 0); the four conversion contracts now permit NULL only for the empty input.
defects.witness: forensics/authorities/src/openssl-3.6.4/crypto/pkcs12/p12_utl.c:45-66 (uni++ after the empty guard); new unit test calls uni2asc(NULL,0), uni2utf8(NULL,0) and asc2uni(NULL,0).

defects.class: secret-bearing scratch not cleansed on a failure path
defects.description: A failed PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC in pkcs12_gen_gost_mac_key left the 96-byte out array uncleansed. That array can hold partial derived key material; the authority's success path cleanses but its failure path returns without cleansing (p12_mutl.c:73-76).
defects.fix: The failure arm cleanses the whole scratch before returning false. Deliberate secret-residue improvement; no observable behaviour, exported symbol, release seam or allocator coordinate changed.

residuals: src/evp/method_store.rs remains the deferred method-store registry boundary.

PKCS8_decrypt_ex answers a parsed PKCS8_PRIV_KEY_INFO released by the item destructor, which does not cleanse the decoded key fields; an unencrypted keyBag in newpass_p12 is released the same way. This is the authority's item-destructor contract and is preserved, not reclassified as safe.
p12_key's out buffer is caller-owned key material; the exported ABI has no length-attached cleansing release.
OPENSSL_asc2uni/utf82uni return password material that the C caller owns; the cleansing release is the caller's obligation under the exported ABI.
The PKCS#12 KDF provider row and constant-time behaviour of the MAC comparisons are outside this file-level batch.
No constant-time claim is made for the PKCS#12 or PKCS#7 units from source inspection.
